framework_detail: Plain HTML + CSS + vanilla JS, no npm, no build step. Flask (Python) serves static files from frontend/public/.
vibe_summary: Cozy cabin meets retro 50s homestead meets Wes Anderson film aesthetics. 70s earth-tone stripe palette: burnt orange, avocado green, rust, warm cream, deep brown, dusty rose, sage. Cartoon-like warmth without being childish. No yellow. No bright colours that hurt text readability. Easy on the eyes, strong contrast on important elements.
do_not: No yellow or bright saturated colours
No childish or cutesy cartoon style
No dark mode (warm light tones only)
primary_flows: Quick-add pantry items via barcode/nutrition label camera scan
Browse community recipe database on mobile
Add friends, see friends favourites and reviews
View nutritional values and allergy info
pain_points: Everything too big and bulky on mobile — can't see enough at once
Small UI glitches make app feel unfinished
Meal plan calendar hard to use on small screen
Nutritional info and allergy data hard to see clearly
